effects: Signing lets anyone call castVoteBySig on the Uniswap Governor Bravo (0x408e…24c3). That casts the signer's vote on proposal `proposalId` with choice `support` (0 Against, 1 For, 2 Abstain).
The vote uses all the UNI voting power delegated to the signer at the proposal's start block. That weight is read from the UNI token's checkpoints, not from the message.
In standard Governor Bravo a vote is final: the signer cannot vote again on that proposal. The Ballot has no nonce and no deadline, so a relayer can submit it at any time while voting is open.
No tokens, ETH or approvals move.
formats.shown: Intent 'Cast vote on Uniswap governance proposal', with the proposal id as a raw number and the vote choice as For / Against / Abstain.

findings.title: Ballot has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line does not say which way or on which proposal.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json display.formats['Ballot(uint256 proposalId,uint8 support)'] has only intent 'Cast vote on Uniswap governance proposal' and no interpolatedIntent. The choice (For/Against/Abstain) and the proposal id appear only in the fields (cases 0-2).

findings.title: Ballot: the voting weight (the signer's delegated UNI at the proposal's start block) is not shown.
findings.evidence: The weight comes from the UNI token's getPriorVotes inside the implementation's castVoteInternal, not from the Ballot message, which carries only proposalId and support.
findings.fix: None possible from the message. The intent could say 'with all your UNI voting power'.

findings.title: Ballot: the proposal id stands for a proposal whose actions and description the screen cannot show.
findings.evidence: Field 'Proposal id' is format raw (cases 0-2 show '178'). What the proposal does is in governor storage.
findings.fix: None in ERC-7730. The signer has to look up the proposal id elsewhere.

findings.title: Ballot: the vote is final, and the signature has no nonce or expiry. The screen says neither.
findings.evidence: The Ballot type is (uint256 proposalId, uint8 support), with no nonce or deadline. In standard Bravo castVoteInternal, a second vote is rejected with 'voter already voted'. The descriptor intent is silent on both.
findings.fix: Optional: put a word like 'final' in the intent. The behaviour itself cannot be shown by any field.

couldNotCheck: GovernorBravoDelegator 0x408ed6354d4973f66138c91495f2f2fcbd8724c3 passes castVoteBySig through its fallback by delegatecall to an implementation (constructor arg 0x53a328F4086d7C0F1Fa19e594c9b842125263026, and possibly upgraded since). No implementation source is in the directory, and meta.json reports isProxy false. So the EIP-712 domain name/type hash, the Ballot type string and the vote logic cannot be checked from the source here.
